"A name. Okay." You say it out loud, trying the shape of it:

Move next to your partner, on the same side of the Haven door.

"Another time. The village needs me here."

"...Think about it? I'll be around."

deathBeat: d8: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Andre Lopez is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d8: 🕯️ Andre Lopez is dead — the wild. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
recoverHome: d9: That night, they bring Andre home. Nobody asks you to help carry; nobody has to. By morning the grave is dug by the fire, and the body is laid out beside it. The filling of it is yours.
systemVoice: d8: SYSTEM: "Perimeter violated! This is unprecedented! ...Is this unprecedented? Checking. Yes. Unprecedented."
d8: SYSTEM: "INTRUDER REPELLED. The pantry’s aroma is now classified as a defensive liability. The audience is chanting the defenders’ names. Fan clubs are forming. This is how it starts."

d8: ◈ THE SPARK — something clicks. A trick Willow learned long ago suddenly has edges it never had. SYSTEM: "ANOMALY: organic unit demonstrates pattern recognition. Slot capacity increased. We are taking notes." (Ability slots: 3)

d8: ◈ ARC III — ENGINES. SYSTEM: "VIEWERSHIP MILESTONE. Organic unit demonstrates compounding capability. Resonance protocols unlocked." — Your gifts deepen. Used in sequence, they resonate. The village is no longer just surviving. It is becoming something.

d8: ◈ SYSTEM: "RATINGS DIP. The audience wants STAKES — pointed ones. A PALISADE. Stockpile 14,000 kcal, 350 wood and 60 stone. Walls make such good television. You will thank us when the teeth come."
d8: ⬢ SYSTEM: "Neural depth 53. I can hold more of you now — ability slots: 4."

d9: ◈ AUDIENCE TRIAL — SYSTEM: "The audience wants an encore. A trial, then — smaller this time, but televised." Fully identify 3 plants (knowledge level 3) within 3 days. Reward: integration, and a lesson.
d10: ◈ SYSTEM: "Ooh. NEIGHBORS. You know what neighbors are for? STORYLINES. Go knock — worst case, it's CONTENT. Best case? The show gets BIGGER."

lines: d8: 📖 The Codex settles deeper into you. It knows things before you do now. Deaths, especially — it will tell you itself.
d8: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Andre Lopez is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d8: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d8: 🕯️ Andre Lopez is dead — the wild. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d8: What Andre kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d8: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Willow blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
d8: 📖 LEARNED: Scrounger (Level 1). Ruin looting finds +1 item.
d8: 📖 LEARNED: Soft Step (Level 1). Move through woods like weather. Less noise, fewer surprises.
